checks.prose: Story 4.1.1 (the rebuild spec's gate G6; spec C5): confirm the ASK-OMID row quoted the SDK licence at its version and date, named what may be published (source that fetches the SDK, compiled images, or both) with a recommendation and a default, and carries Omid's answer first-hand; and that docs/build/gates.md records G6 with that answer. Auto-fail: a firmware image published before the answer.

Story 4.1.2 (spec D5; an environment-dependent arm: Windows, macOS and Linux): confirm the firmware builds with free tools only (CMake, TI Arm Clang or the Arm GNU route, SysConfig at the SDK's default PHY settings); that TI's SDK is fetched by a script at a pinned version and never committed; that the build is MEASURED on each of the three platforms, each with the operating system, the date and each tool's printed version; and that the licence terms Epic 2.1's close routed here (SysConfig's, TI Arm Clang's, the Arm GNU route's and TI's download page's) are read and cited at their version and date, any term that is not free filed in the ASK-OMID register. Auto-fail: a platform claimed with no run recorded.

Story 4.1.3: confirm the protocol library lays out the 250 ms frame (the beacon with its commands and count, the Field Generators' block, the joining window, the downlink slot and the 0.7333 ms reply slots), the count each Field Generator's slot repeats, the US hop order given at joining (42 channels, 10.5 s a cycle) and the EU site's channels named at joining; and that its host-run tests pin each figure, each citing the study line it is read from. Auto-fail: a figure that differs from docs/study/radio-and-location.md with no recorded reason.

Story 4.1.4: confirm the Reader's image runs the beacon, the roll calls and its own zone slot on the development board; that its binary frames, closed by a CRC, decode against the published event schema in a host-run test; and that the wire's baud cites the USB bridge's datasheet (Story 3.1.4) in place of the ASSUMED 921,600.

Story 4.1.5: confirm the Field Generator's image sends its ID and the count in its own slot of the Reader's block at a settable power, that an exit's Field Generator also listens, and that a host-run test pins the slot's timing.

Story 4.1.6: confirm the tag's image keeps the listen set the Reader names, skips the beacon on most listens with time kept on the 32 kHz crystal, checks in at each style's interval (2 s, 1 s, 12 s), takes its style as a setting, wakes on the tamper loop, and sets the TMP117's averaging per tag with eight averages by default; and that host-run tests pin the listen layout and the intervals.

Story 4.1.7 (decisions 3b and 3c): confirm the tag's image runs a lost tag's search as docs/study/radio-and-location.md states it (its window, its searches held at 6.6 microamps, its own Reader's channel first, then the site's channels with the spare left out) and, at a site of more than one network, the wide search a tag carried past a Reader's edge starts, with the trigger and the network it joins as Stories 2.1.18 and 2.1.20 state them; and that host-run tests pin the order, the trigger and the timing against the study's figures, a carried tag shown within requirements.md [22]'s 5 minutes.

Story 4.1.8: confirm docs/evidence/4.1.8/README.md names each committed file, what it shows, the date it was taken and the instrument, and that the beacon's and a Field Generator slot's lengths are measured on the brought-up boards, on the receiver or a logic capture, and written into the studies in place of the ASSUMED 1.0 ms and 0.4 ms; that every figure it reports is MEASURED with its date and written into the studies where it replaces an ASSUMED or INFERRED one; and that nothing in it shows a face, an address, a hostname or a screen beyond the measurement (CLAUDE.md, Writing in public). Omid's verdict, on the closer's evidence. Auto-fail: a file the README does not name, or a figure with no date.
